resignation-letter.name: Resignation letter
resignation-letter.blurb: Two weeks' notice letter or email.

resignation-letter.q1: What should a resignation letter include?
resignation-letter.a1: The date, who it is addressed to, a clear statement that you are resigning from your position, your last working day and your signature. Thanks and an offer to help with the handover are usual but optional. You do not have to say why you are leaving.
resignation-letter.q2: Do I have to give two weeks' notice?
resignation-letter.a2: In the US most jobs are at will, and two weeks is a custom rather than a law, though your contract or company policy may ask for more. In the UK you must give at least one week's notice once you have worked there for a month, or longer if your contract says so. Check your contract.
resignation-letter.q3: Should I resign by letter or by email?
resignation-letter.a3: Many employers accept an email. A printed, signed letter is common where the contract asks for written notice. Choose Email for a subject line and a short sign-off, or Printed letter for the addresses and space to sign.
resignation-letter.q4: How do I save the letter as a PDF?
resignation-letter.a4: Press Print / Save as PDF and pick "Save as PDF" as the printer. Only the letter is printed, not the rest of the page. Download Word gives a .docx file you can edit in Word, Pages or Google Docs.
resignation-letter.q5: Is what I type sent anywhere?
resignation-letter.a5: No. The letter is written in your browser, the draft is kept only in this browser's storage, and the PDF and Word files are made on your device.

resignation-letter.lead: Write your resignation letter in three steps.
